description_sq:
Shitet nje apartament me siperfaqe totale 78 m2 i ndare ne 2 apartamente , 1+1 dhe Garsoniere.
Apartamentet ndodhen ne katin 4 te nje objekti ekzistues.
Te dyja apartamentet jane te rinovuara plotesisht me punime cilesore,dhe jepen momentalisht me qira ditore.
Objekti ku ndodhet prona eshte buze rruges se Durresit,dhe ka nje akses shume te mire me rruget qendore te Tiranes.
Prona disponon certifikate pronesie dhe shitet me cmimin 185.000 Euro.
Per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone mund te na kontaktoni.
title_en: Apartment for sale at the Colosseo hotel
description_en: An apartment for sale with a total area of ​​78 m2, divided into 2 apartments, 1+1 and Studio. The apartments are located on the 4th floor of an existing building. Both apartments are completely renovated with quality work, and are currently available for daily rent. The facility where the property is located is on the edge of the Durres road, and has very good access to the central roads of Tirana. The property has ownership certificates and is sold at the price of 185,000 Euros. For more information or a visit to the property, you can contact us.
